title: Seal holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#a8c8e8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7a9cc4'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='bellyGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e4eef8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c8daea'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M28 78 Q18 74 16 82 Q22 88 30 84 Q34 82 36 80 Z' fill='#6a8cb4'/>
  <path d='M28 78 Q20 76 20 82 Q24 86 30 83 Z' fill='#8aa8c8'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='24' ry='26' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='15' ry='17' fill='url(#bellyGrad)'/>
  <!-- flippers -->
  <path d='M27 58 Q18 66 20 78 Q21 84 27 82 Q30 76 30 66 Z' fill='#6a8cb4'/>
  <path d='M73 58 Q82 66 80 78 Q79 84 73 82 Q70 76 70 66 Z' fill='#6a8cb4'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='20' ry='18' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#c8daea'/>

  <ellipse cx='42' cy='33' rx='3.2' ry='3.8' fill='#2a3a58'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='33' rx='3.2' ry='3.8' fill='#2a3a58'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='31.5' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='31.5' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='39' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#3a4a68'/>
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='38' rx='1' ry='0.8' fill='#7088a8'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 44 Q50 47 54 44' stroke='#4a5a78' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='38' y1='41' x2='30' y2='39' stroke='#8aa8c8' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='43' x2='30' y2='44' stroke='#8aa8c8' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='41' x2='70' y2='39' stroke='#8aa8c8' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='43' x2='70' y2='44' stroke='#8aa8c8' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- heart held at belly -->
  <path d='M50 56 Q44 50 40 54 Q37 58 42 63 L50 70 L58 63 Q63 58 60 54 Q56 50 50 56 Z' fill='#ff4d6a'/>
  <path d='M50 58 Q46 54 43 56 Q41 58 44 61 L50 66 Z' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
  <!-- heart shine -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='56' rx='2' ry='1.4' fill='#ffe0e6' transform='rotate(-20 45 56)'/>
  <!-- front flippers holding heart -->
  <path d='M36 62 Q32 58 34 54 Q38 56 40 60 Z' fill='#7a9cc4'/>
  <path d='M64 62 Q68 58 66 54 Q62 56 60 60 Z' fill='#7a9cc4'/>
</svg>
